article.en: While John Gilbert was in hospital, he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful.
article.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院时，问医生他的手术是否成功。

article.en: The doctor refused to tell him.
The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
article.zh: 第二天，这位病人要了一部床头电话。

article.en: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
article.zh: 他独自一人时，给医院总机打了电话，要找米灵顿医生。

article.en: When the doctor answered the phone, Mr Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient, a Mr John Gilbert.
article.zh: 医生接起电话后，吉尔伯特先生说，他想询问一位病人的情况——一位名叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生。

article.en: He asked if the operation had been successful and the doctor told him that it had been.
article.zh: 他问手术是否成功，医生告诉他手术很成功。

article.en: He then asked when Mr Gilbert would be allowed to go home.
article.zh: 然后他又问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以回家。

article.en: The doctor told him that he would have to stay in hospital for another two weeks.
article.zh: 医生告诉他，他还得在医院再住两个星期。

article.en: Then Dr Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
article.zh: 接着米灵顿医生问打电话的人是否是病人的亲属。

article.en: 'No,' the patient answered, 'I am Mr John Gilbert.'
article.zh: “不，”病人回答说，“我就是约翰·吉尔伯特先生。”
